container: background-color: #ffffff; padding: 44px 18px; letter-spacing: 0.3px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
h2: font-size: 30px; font-weight: 900; color: #111111; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.5px; border-top: 1px solid #e0e0e0; padding-top: 28px; margin: 52px 0 20px
h2_first: font-size: 30px; font-weight: 900; color: #111111; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.5px; margin: 0 0 20px
h3: font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #111111; letter-spacing: 4px; margin: 30px 0 14px; text-transform: uppercase
blockquote: background-color: #f2f2f2; border-left: 3px solid #e0e0e0; padding: 12px 16px; margin: 0 0 16px; color: #5a5a5a; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8
code: color: #3a3a3a; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
inline_code: background-color: #f2f2f2; color: #111111; padding: 1px 5px; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace; letter-spacing: 0
th: border-bottom: 2px solid #111111; color: #111111; font-weight: 800; padding: 12px 10px; font-size: 14px
